desc: Implement two-layer Dijkstra (2N states, original edges in layer 0, reversed edges in layer 1, cost-X toggles between layers) reading from stdin and printing min(dist[N][0], dist[N][1]).
Test the implementation against Sample 1 (5 6 5): expect 4.
Test the implementation against Sample 2 (5 6 1): expect 3.
Test the implementation against Sample 3 (8 7 613566756): expect 4294967299 (verify 64-bit/Python big-int handling).
Test the implementation against Sample 4 (20 13 5): expect 21.
